job_description:
Application Developer Senior – Regulatory Reporting

General

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline.
• 3-5 years of experience in the development and deployment of n-tier enterprise applications
• Formal experience in working in projects with a methodology
• Must possess strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Exceptional customer service skills required. Looking for a highly motivated individual that likes to be challenged.
• Candidate must actively and independently strive to broaden technology and business knowledge.
• Must possess knowledge and experience supporting and delivering Regulatory Reporting solutions for major financial institutions (FR Y-9C, FFIEC 031 Call Report, FR Y-14M, etc…)
• Designs and codes application programs; performs testing for developed applications.
• Reviews, analyzes, and modifies programming systems, including encoding, testing, debugging and installing for a large-scale system.
• Ensures the operating efficiency of existing application systems. Maintains records for the documentation of systems development and revisions.
• Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques, and the ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical (hardware, software, application or operational) problems.

Technical Skills

• Experience in analyzing requirements and developing data structures to meet those requirements.
• Experience using both Windows and Unix/Linux server technologies
• Experience with SQL/PLSQL and Oracle databases
• Experience in object-oriented programming (Java, C#, Python, etc.)
• Experience in business analytics
• Experience using an ETL technology and in-depth knowledge of the ETL process a plus
• Experience with Teradata, Data Warehouses and their technologies a plus
• Experience supporting and configuration of AxiomSL application a plus
